category.food.name: Food & Langars
item.food.government-food-camps.name: Government Food Camps

item.food.akhara-langars.name: Akhara Langars
item.food.akhara-langars.detail: Religious organizations serve free food to all pilgrims.
item.food.akhara-langars.location: Near major akharas in tent city
item.food.mela-food-courts.name: Mela Food Courts
item.food.mela-food-courts.detail: Certified stalls with snacks, thalis, and tea.
item.food.mobile-canteens.name: Mobile Canteens
item.food.mobile-canteens.detail: IRCTC and MP Tourism mobile canteens with standard pricing and hygienic food.
category.water.name: Drinking Water
category.water.warning: Do NOT drink river water. Use designated drinking water points only.
item.water.drinking-water-kiosks.name: Drinking Water Kiosks
item.water.drinking-water-kiosks.detail: RO-purified water kiosks every 200-300 meters across the mela grounds.
item.water.packaged-water.name: Packaged Water
item.water.packaged-water.detail: ISI-marked bottled water from certified vendors.
category.sanitation.name: Toilets & Sanitation
category.sanitation.tip: Locate the nearest toilet block when you arrive at any sector.
Permanent and mobile toilet blocks throughout the mela grounds.
item.sanitation.mobile-toilet-vans.name: Mobile Toilet Vans
item.sanitation.mobile-toilet-vans.detai: Mobile toilet units deployed during peak days and near congested areas.
item.sanitation.mobile-toilet-vans.locat: Amrit Snan routes and crowded ghats
item.sanitation.pink-toilets-women.name: Pink Toilets (Women)
item.sanitation.pink-toilets-women.detai: Dedicated facilities for women at all major sectors.
category.banking.name: ATMs & Banking
category.banking.tip: Carry ₹2,000-3,000 cash on major bathing days. ATMs may run dry.
item.banking.atms.name: ATMs
item.banking.atms.detail: SBI, HDFC, ICICI, PNB ATMs deployed across the mela grounds.
item.banking.upi-digital-payments.name: UPI / Digital Payments
item.banking.upi-digital-payments.detail: Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm accepted at most certified stalls.
item.banking.currency-exchange.name: Currency Exchange
item.banking.currency-exchange.detail: RBI-authorized foreign exchange counters for international pilgrims.
item.banking.currency-exchange.location: Near Sector 1 main entrance, Ujjain mela grounds
category.charging.name: Phone Charging
category.charging.warning: ⚠️ A dead phone = serious risk. Always keep at least 30% battery. Carry a power bank!
item.charging.phone-charging-stations.de: Solar-powered and grid-connected charging stations set up across the mela.
item.charging.phone-charging-stations.lo: Near food courts and waiting areas at all major sectors
item.charging.power-banks.name: Power Banks
item.charging.power-banks.detail: Carry your own power bank (10,000 mAh minimum recommended). Available to purchase at Ujjain and Indore markets.
item.charging.power-banks.location: Purchase at Freeganj or Tower Chowk market, Ujjain before entering the mela
category.accommodation-nearby.name: Local Accommodation
category.accommodation-nearby.tip: 💡 Book accommodation 2-3 months before the event. Prices triple close to the event.
item.accommodation-nearby.kumbh-tent-cit: Organized tent cities with cots, blankets, and basic amenities in Simhastha Kumbh sectors near Ram Ghat, Ujjain.
Sectors 1-20, near Ram Ghat & Kshipra riverbank
item.accommodation-nearby.dharamshalas.d: Traditional pilgrim rest houses run by temples and religious organizations in Ujjain. Book in advance.
item.accommodation-nearby.dharamshalas.l: Freeganj, Kothi Road, near Mahakal Temple
item.accommodation-nearby.indore-hotels-: When Ujjain is full, Indore (55 km) hotels are a great base. Daily commute by train (1 hr) or road (1.5 hrs).
Indore city — well connected to Ujjain
